topic: Spec and coordination for telemetry export feature

messages.text: Draft API surfaces: /export/start, /export/status and /export/chunk. I'm worried about bursts if chunk size defaults to something tiny.
I skimmed the DeepWiki docs on exporter chunking; they recommend ~64MB chunks and explain retry semantics. Might be relevant for our throttling design.
Also saw some logs showing repeated retries yesterday — might be from a misconfigured client.
Opened issue #88 to track client-side backoff and idempotency for exports. Link in the issue references the docs Ben mentioned.
Good catch. Can you paste any sample request IDs here?
Quick ask: can you pull the DeepWiki export docs and forward the key recommendations to Infra? They want concrete chunk/timeout numbers.
For infra: what's the latency profile for our storage? That affects ideal chunk size too.
Infra question: what chunk size should we bake into the pipeline? We've heard 64MB from telemetry but need confirmation.
Forwarded to Infra. I included estimated chunk/timeout numbers in the note.
Also worth noting: the docs call out idempotency tokens and suggested retry windows — we'll need to reflect that in the API surface.
We have 95th percentile at ~120ms; large chunks reduce overhead but increase retransmit cost.
